places.name: Helsinki Zen Center
places.notes: The official Sanneji Zen page lists guided meditation four to five times weekly, a current weekly schedule, and 2026 events at Pääskylänrinne 3. Its tradition page describes the Harada–Yasutani line.

places.name: Sanneji Zen Temple
places.notes: Official pages describe a year-round residential practice and retreat center, visitor participation, and a current October 2026 sesshin. The tradition page describes Harada–Yasutani roots.

places.name: Sanneji Zendo Turku
places.notes: The current official page lists Tuesday and Thursday evening and Sunday morning zazen at Käsityöläiskatu 5 b. This Sanneji group is distinct from Kajo Zendo Turku.

places.name: Tampere Zen Center
places.notes: The official site publishes 2026 practice and retreat dates and identifies its Yasutani–Kapleau tradition and teacher Mitra Virtaperko. Consult the current schedule for venue details.

places.name: Sydänmieli Zen Helsinki
places.notes: The official site lists regular meditation, retreats, and its Albertinkatu address. Its teacher page describes the Yasutani–Kapleau tradition and Mitra Virtaperko’s 2026 teaching authorization.

places.name: Kajo Zendo Turku
places.notes: The group’s current page lists Thursday 17:30 Sōtō zazen and 2026 zazenkai dates. It asks newcomers to contact the group and does not publish a current street address.
